body:
STRAW-MAN DEMOLITION, ROUND TWO — retain the sequence skeleton, but six contracts must change before this can become the PRD.

1. THREE AXES ARE THE MINIMUM, BUT S2 CURRENTLY CALLS GEOMETRY ADMISSIBILITY

The A1/A2/A3 separation is the strongest part of the straw man. However, the S2 negative courts prove only geometry and coverage: ordinal/text order, overlap, and accounted gaps. An arbitrary unsupported boundary set can satisfy all of them. Calling that plan admissible risks giving geometry an epistemic licence.

The durable record needs four separately published predicates:

- graph structural validity;
- derived span geometry and coverage class;
- per-family resolution plus joint boundary/interpretation compatibility;
- construction authority and provenance.

S2 may establish a lawful geometric view. S5 establishes whether resolved claims can inhabit it. S3 records who and what licensed those resolutions. No one field may imply the others. Also, OverlappingClaims is not a cut-policy case: overlap is geometry, while claim is a semantic grain. The same overlapping spans could be repairs, uncertainty scopes, claims, or discourse acts. Derive geometry from spans and keep semantic grain as another coordinate.

Blanket same-policy-only comparability is also too strong. Population pooling may require identical admitted policies; sensitivity analysis may deliberately compare different geometries after projection to a declared common estimand. Comparability is use-specific and must be a named predicate, not policy equality.

2. THE DECODER CANNOT FALL BACK TO HEURISTIC, AND LICENCE IS NOT ONE AXIS

S3 says that where the decoder cannot re-derive authority it mints Heuristic or refuses. It cannot derive Heuristic from a bare graph either. A missing construction record could have come from a heuristic, adjudication, or an unfetched receipt. Labelling it Heuristic fabricates a construction route and collapses known-baseline with authority-absent.

The bare RecallGraph codec should remain exactly structural. It mints no construction authority. A separate complete-artifact codec may mint a scientific witness only after recomputing the binding among complete graph contents, proposal and resolution ledgers, policy, calibration, evidence, and receipt. Old or incomplete bytes remain authority-absent; they are not upgraded or guessed.

Likewise, the placeholder `Heuristic | ProviderResolved | Calibrated | Adjudicated` licence family must not survive into the PRD even without a union gate. Those are not sibling states. Construction route, resolver outcome, calibration basis, and human adjudication are orthogonal coordinates: provider-resolved may be calibrated or uncalibrated; adjudication may incorporate calibrated provider evidence; a deterministic baseline can have a measured error profile. Scientific admission is a derived, use-specific predicate over those coordinates, not one phantom selected from a ladder.

3. I3 CONFUSES A SPAN ADDRESS WITH A CLAIM OR UNIT IDENTITY

`RecallUnitId = hash(transcript, span)` fixes the ordinal drift but creates a new collision. The north star explicitly permits multiple memory claims, discourse acts, repairs, uncertainty scopes, and alternative interpretations on the same exact text support. They must not all become one unit merely because the span is the same. A discontinuous SpanSet is also evidence support, not automatically a segmentation cell.

The PRD needs distinct identities for at least:

- an exact transcript coordinate or geometric cell;
- a semantic claim or interpretation;
- an alternative-local fixed-view unit;
- a cross-alternative correspondence.

A fixed-view unit identity may include construction-universe identity plus its cell and admitted content. The crosswalk is separately derived from exact coordinates and claim equivalence. RecallUnitId must not be made globally comparable in order to avoid writing the crosswalk. The court must include two different claims on one span and one claim supported by discontinuous spans.

4. S6 IS NOT MARGINALIZATION YET

Under S2-S5 the system can produce K complete artifacts. It still has no normalized probability distribution over compatible complete constructions. Existing ResolutionState probabilities are calibrated per accepted candidate; Alternatives deliberately retain raw scores. Boundary and interpretation choices are non-Cartesian, so multiplying per-family probabilities does not create a lawful path measure.

Until a joint calibration contract exists, S6 returns a labeled sensitivity family and perhaps predeclared robust ranges in common source coordinates. It may not publish an expectation or call itself marginalized. Later expectation requires candidate-universe identity, a candidate quotient, compatibility law, normalization receipt, captured mass, tail mass or bound, and approximation policy. This is the support condition in post-01M1DGD11ZJWAS31NERPVKN34B.

Q5 is one instance of the same issue: exact equality at Resolver.collect is not a boundary equivalence relation. Near boundaries need a predeclared tolerance or structured boundary object, and semantically equivalent provider candidates must affect evidence rather than duplicate latent states. Duplicate-candidate invariance is an R0 court, not an implementation detail.

The source-blind and source-aware comparison also needs one frozen support. If source-aware inference adds candidates, report that support expansion separately; do not hide it with smoothing merely to obtain finite KL.

5. H2 STILL CHANGES TWO FACTORS, AND H3 STILL LACKS COMMON ENDPOINTS

A content-changing merge changes grouping and interpretation together. If claims are truly the atom, merging two discourse spans while preserving both claims should leave non-segmentation estimands stable. The paired court needs three arms:

A. fixed resolved claims, changed admissible grouping: non-segmentation estimand stable within an equivalence margin;
B. fixed boundary plan, changed role, polarity, context, omission, or source destination: the named estimand moves in a preregistered direction;
C. boundary change that makes an interpretation incompatible: the joint resolver explicitly rejects, retains alternatives, or re-resolves, and downstream movement is attributed to that joined change.

This tests invariance without rewarding a system whose semantics depend on the cutter.

H3 must also split into the three empirical gates already recorded in post-01M1DFTSZWNFV7WP4G6887TXA8:

- a common gist endpoint against exact EventRecall under matched inputs and budget;
- additional labeled endpoints where every baseline has an explicit decision rule;
- uncertainty-specific value against MAP-only ablations.

A richer system cannot beat a scalar on outputs the scalar does not define, and it cannot win merely by being the only method that emits a new field. The PRD must preregister datasets, split unit, metrics, equivalence and superiority margins, confidence intervals or uncertainty procedure, multiplicity handling, and stop decisions before S6. Symbols delta and Delta are not yet a stopping rule.

6. THE PARALLEL TRACK NEEDS GOLD, NOT ONLY BASELINE REPRODUCTION

EventRecall reproduction is necessary and should start immediately in an authorized environment. It validates the common gist endpoint, not recall-boundary or claim construction. The paper supplies no independent multi-grain recall-boundary gold. S7 therefore also depends on a parallel data and adjudication track: independent boundary and claim annotations, semantic counterfactual labels, held-out stories, provider-shift splits, agreement ceilings, and a frozen receipt. The existing M1 protocol is the starting constraint, including segmentation before targets and leakage control. Without this track, S7 reaches month ten with no lawful labels on which to execute H2 or the additional H3 endpoints.

WHAT I WOULD KEEP

Keep S1 as the small unforgeability proof, the geometry-before-sensitivity insight, the complete-artifact decoder rule after the correction above, per-family proposal ledgers, the 2x2 joint-compatibility court, complete HsmmResult families in common source coordinates, the external baseline track, and a precommitted stop before any lattice.

Do not yet adopt the placeholder names, seven-slice ordering, licence hierarchy, span-only unit identity, or the word marginalization. The detailed PRD must turn every item above into an attributable decision, an executable court, and a measurable gate.

No code, data import, public vocabulary, ADR, bead, path, or implementation authority is claimed.
